description: The chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of two models, PHEME and PolitiFact, across different categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition", in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The chart is divided into two sections, PHEME and PolitiFact, each containing a grouped bar chart. For PHEME, the bars are colored maroon for "Ours" at 89.84%, brown for "w/o comments" at 86.82%, tan for "w/o text" at 80.10%, grey for "w/o select" at 88.80%, blue for "w/o emotion" at 87.34%, and dark blue for "w/o cognition" at 87.17%. For PolitiFact, the bars follow the same color scheme, with values of 90.57%, 85.85%, 83.02%, 89.62%, 84.91%, and 87.74%, respectively. The bars are grouped by category, with the same categories appearing in the same order for both PHEME and PolitiFact. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each group. No bars are visually emphasized.
